description: Maps player-card emblem rows to a character and rarity grade so the UI can select the matching emblem item artwork for a profile.

Id.technical: FName key saved in FGamePlayerCardParameter::EmblemId and packed into leaderboard cards as a numeric string. Validate() resets the ID to '10' when no row exists; ResetUnownedIds also resets to '10' when the corresponding owned/unlocked emblem item is missing. Customize tiles copy the row ID into their tile item and then map to an Item row through VariableId for the new-item flag.

GradeType.technical: EGameEmblemGradeType (None, Grade1..Grade4, Invalid=255). SetEmblem casts it to uint8 and passes it with Id_Character to PlayerCard_FindEmblemItemId, which scans emblem rows for the same character/grade pair, then finds an Emblem-typed Item row whose VariableId is that emblem row's Id; the resulting Item ID selects the emblem texture. Exported rows use Grade1..Grade4.

Id_Character.simple: Character whose emblem design this row represents.
Id_Character.technical: FName compared against the selected character ID in PlayerCard_FindEmblemItemId. Together with GradeType it identifies the emblem row whose ID is used to find the Emblem Item row and thus the texture asset. Owned-emblem collection also joins from Item::VariableId back to this row's Id.

notes: The export contains 113 rows across four grades and 29 character IDs. Multiple PlayerCardEmblemDataTable shards are supported; finders use the first row matching the ID.

This row has no direct texture field: the display path is Emblem row -> (Id_Character, GradeType) lookup -> matching Emblem Item row's ID -> GetEmblemTexture. The reverse path for ownership is Item::VariableId -> Emblem row.
Only the supplied retail export and partial Content are available; no claim is made about all Blueprint or editor-tool uses.

usages.detail: Builds the owned emblem row list by resolving owned/unlocked Emblem Item rows' VariableId to emblem rows.
Finds the emblem Item row for a character/grade pair using Id_Character and GradeType.
Draws the emblem texture selected by the saved emblem ID through the row's character/grade pair.
Builds owned emblem selection tiles and uses the row ID to query new-item state.
